messages:
Maya Patel: Heads up — Candidate Evelyn Park (Staff ML Eng) is coming onsite Tue 2025-04-22. ETA 09:15, first interview 09:45. Need: building access badge, parking permit, vegetarian lunch, lactation room (if needed), and a short arrival escort. Can folks confirm owners?
Megan Lee: I can handle parking permit + lunch. Do we have dietary restrictions beyond veg?
Maya Patel: Candidate noted vegetarian + pescatarian OK. Also prefers a quiet space to prep for 20 mins.
Diego Ramos: Can we put her first panel in Conf Rm B (2nd floor)? Projector not needed. I'll be on the panel with Alex and Priya. @Alex Kim you good for 9:45?
Alex Kim: 9:45 works. I'll need the room to have HDMI dongle + whiteboard markers. Also planning to bring my laptop.
Megan Lee: Got it re: lunch — ordering from GreenLeaf. Need headcount by 4/21 11:00. Who else should I include?
Maya Patel: Interviewers: Diego Ramos, Alex Kim, Priya Shah (hiring manager), Jordan Lee (cross-team). Add two interviewers for culture/pm pair TBD.
Diego Ramos: Can we have an early buffer? Candidate flight arrives at 08:50, customs could vary. If delayed we should have a fallback: remote loop via Zoom.
Maya Patel: Noted. I'll set up a Zoom fallback and include instructions in the invite.
Megan Lee: Facilities: @FacilitiesBot — can you create a one-day visitor badge for Evelyn Park on 2025-04-22, badge pickup at Reception, and a short escort to 2nd floor? Also need a lactation room code (temporary) and single stall restroom access noted.
FacilitiesBot: Auto-response: Request received. Visitor badge for Evelyn Park scheduled for 2025-04-22. Badge pickup: Reception between 08:30–10:30. Escort assigned: Floor Ops team. Parking permit (visitor) being generated; permit code will be DM'ed to requester. Lactation room access note added.
Alex Kim: Quick ask — can we get a quiet prep room reserved from 09:10–09:35? Candidate requested ~20 mins.
Megan Lee: Reserving Conf Rm D 09:05–09:40 now.
Diego Ramos: Also need candidate phone number and emergency contact for on-site admin — Maya can you drop that in DM not here?
Maya Patel: Sending phone in DM. Also adding travel arrival info to the calendar invite.
Megan Lee: Reimbursements — if candidate pays parking, we cover via expense. Maya: please include reimbursement instructions in the confirmation email.
Maya Patel: Will do. Draft invite details block (will paste into calendar invite):
```
Subject: Redwood Onsite Interview — Evelyn Park
When: Tue Apr 22, 09:15 arrival (prep 09:15–09:35), interviews 09:45–12:00
Location: Redwood HQ, 2nd floor, Conf Rm B (panel), Conf Rm D (prep)
Zoom fallback: https://redwood.zoom.us/j/xxx
Reception badge pickup: 08:30–10:30
Parking: Visitor permit code will be DM'ed to candidate/admin
Lunch: Vegetarian (GreenLeaf) — notify Megan if changes
Point of contact on arrival: Maya Patel (ext 4321)
```
Megan Lee: Thumbs-up on the invite. I'll order lunch for 6 (candidate + 5 interviewers).
Alex Kim: One more — can we ensure laptop power strips in Conf Rm B?
FacilitiesBot: Noted. Power strip x2 + spare markers will be staged in Conf Rm B by 08:00 on 2025-04-22.
Diego Ramos: If candidate needs remote keyboard/mouse adapter, we'll have a spare.
Maya Patel: Thanks all. Action owners: Megan — lunch & prep room, FacilitiesBot — badge/permit/room setup, Diego/Alex/Priya/Jordan — interviewers confirmed, Maya — invite + Zoom fallback + reimburse note. Please flag anything I missed by EOD 4/18. :thumbsup:
Megan Lee: All set from my side.
Alex Kim: All good.
Diego Ramos: All good.
FacilitiesBot: Reminder will post on 2025-04-21 09:00 with pickup/code details.
